title: Per-model calibration matrix and runtime fallback for FP8/INT8 defaults
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a per-model 'calibration matrix' that records recommended quant profiles (FP8 / INT8 / FP16) along with expected accuracy delta, latency/cost impact, and guardrail thresholds. Wire this matrix into the model catalog so that the serving runtime and the Console can default to safe quantization presets for each model and enable runtime fallbacks if regressions are detected.
background: We have multiple efforts for quant defaults and automated tuning, but product UX and runtime behavior remain fragmented: catalog-level defaults lack a structured mapping between workload sensitivity and quant profile, and runtime needs a clear policy to fall back automatically without manual intervention. Operators also need visibility into why a certain profile was chosen and a simple path to request re-calibration.
proposal: Add a 'calibration matrix' entity to the model catalog: for each model/version, store prioritized quant profiles, target evaluation datasets (prompt families), expected quality deltas (90/95/99th percentile), recommended inference knobs (batch size, kv-cache policy), and guardrail thresholds (max token-level perplexity increase, acceptable top-k/answer-flip rate). Expose these defaults in Console and SDK. Implement a runtime policy that can: 1) select the catalog default at deploy time; 2) monitor live quality/regressions via sampling probes; 3) step down to a safer profile or route to a fallback FP16 endpoint when thresholds are breached. Include an operator override and audit trail.
calibration_workflow: 1) Curate per-model calibration sets: assemble ~500–2k representative prompts across taxonomy buckets (instructions, code, summarization, multi-turn) and define scoring metrics for each family. 2) Run automated calibration harness that generates quantized variants (FP8, INT8 with different clipping/scale heuristics) and measures accuracy/latency/cost. 3) Fit a compact calibration matrix entry that lists prioritized profiles and numeric deltas. 4) Human-in-the-loop review (ML engineer + PM) for any profile with >2% accuracy regression on critical families. 5) Publish defaults to catalog with a confidence score and recommended runtime SLO window.
validation_plan:
- Unit: calibration harness reproducibility tests covering model weight seeds and quant seeds.
- Integration: model-catalog ingestion + Console display + runtime pick-and-route.
- Regression: run nightly evals on held-out prompt families and compare to baseline (FP16).
- Golden checks: for top-10 customer-facing models, run expanded evals and require sign-off before defaults are auto-promoted.
- Canary: enable profile for small fleet (5–10%) with active traffic and additional logging to sentiment/answer-flip detectors.
risk_mitigation:
- Conservative guardrails: default to safer profile when confidence low.
- Rollback path: immediate route-to-FP16 fallback endpoint and alerting on any significant quality degradation.
- Sampling: increase sampling rate for models with low calibration confidence.
- Human gating: require ML engineer review for any model where quantization increases hallucination markers or critical metric regressions.
- Audit logs: store before/after calibration matrices for troubleshooting.
metrics:
- Quality: answer-flip rate, exact-match / ROUGE / BLEU / task-specific metric deltas vs FP16 baseline.
- Latency: p50/p95 generation latency delta.
- Cost: per-token compute cost change.
- Operational: number of runtime fallbacks triggered per week, time-to-detect regression, time-to-recover.
- Confidence: calibration matrix confidence (0–1) from automated harness.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1: implement catalog schema and offline calibration harness; publish matrix for internal models only.
Phase 2: enable Console display and API to opt-in; run canary on non-sensitive customer traffic.
Phase 3: enable auto-apply defaults for new model uploads with 'auto-quant=opt-in' flag and monitor for 2 weeks.
Phase 4: full catalog defaults auto-apply with runtime fallback enabled and dashboards for SRE/ML.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration matrix persisted in model catalog for test models
